changed.title: A fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit for the unrestricted shared-key witness moment at any order and fixed schedule
changed.statement:
∀ (k r h t : ℕ), 0 < h → h ≤ k → 0 < t →
  let rot := fun (d x : ℕ) => ((x <<< (d % k)) ||| (x >>> (k-d % k))) % 2^k
  let chi := fun (x : ℕ) => (List.range k).foldl (fun (acc i : ℕ) =>
    acc ||| ((xor (x.testBit i) (!(x.testBit ((i+1) % k)) && x.testBit ((i+2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let run := fun (masks : ℕ → Fin (2^k)) (col : Bool) (key name : ℕ) =>
    let gap : ℕ := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.range r).foldl (fun z j =>
      let mixed := z ^^^ rot gap z ^^^ rot (k-gap % k) z
      chi mixed ^^^ rot (if col then 3*(j+1)+1 else 2*j) key ^^^
        (masks (if col then r+j else j)).val) (rot (if col then 3 else 1) key ^^^ name)
  let B := if r = 0 then 2 else if r = 1 then 7 else 7*r-2
  let seam := fun (b : ℕ) => min k (h+b-k)
  let A := 2^(B+seam B+1)
  let scan := 2^(10*r+seam (4*r)+seam (6*r)+2) * Nat.choose (t+A-1) t
  let wiresIn := 2*r*k+2*h
  let bits := fun (len word : ℕ) => (List.range len).map (fun i => word.testBit i)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (out : Fin ((t+2)*k+1) → Fin (wiresIn+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack wiresIn C ∧
    C.output < wiresIn+C.size ∧
    C.size ≤ 1048576*((k+1)*(r+1)*(t+2))^4 * min (2^(3*k)) scan ∧
    ∀ (masks : ℕ → Fin (2^k)) (a b : Fin (2^h)),
      let input := (List.range (2*r)).flatMap (fun j => bits k (masks j).val) ++
        bits h a.val ++ bits h b.val
      let num := fun (x y : Fin (2^k)) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun key : Fin (2^k) =>
        (run masks false key.val x.val >>> (k-h)) = a.val ∧
        (run masks true key.val y.val >>> (k-h)) = b.val)).card
      let moment := ∑ x : Fin (2^k), ∑ y : Fin (2^k), (num x y)^t
      ∀ j : Fin ((t+2)*k+1), (C.wires input).getD (out j).val false = moment.testBit j.val

changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
    xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
        (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (Q.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun h => ds.getD h 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD Q.output 0
∀ (n m a t E : ℕ) (T : Fin n → Fin m → Bool)
  (row : Fin n → Option (Fin a)) (bags : ℕ → Finset (Fin m))
  (u : Fin n) (q : Fin m) (_ : row u = none) (w : Fin n × Fin m → ℕ),
  (∀ i j k : Fin a, i ≤ j → j ≤ k → bags i.val ∩ bags k.val ⊆ bags j.val) →
  let cut := fun j : ℕ => if 0 < j ∧ j < a then bags (j-1) ∩ bags j else ∅
  let R := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun x => row x = none)
  let rows := fun i : Fin a => R ∪ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => row x = some i)
  let entry := fun x y => ((T x y).toNat : ZMod 2)
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun x y => entry x y + entry x q + entry u y + entry u q
  let rk := fun (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2)) (I : Finset (Fin n)) (J : Finset (Fin m)) =>
    Matrix.rank (B.submatrix (fun x : I => x.val) (fun y : J => y.val))
  let X := Fin m → (ZMod 2)
  let State := Submodule (ZMod 2) X
  let supported := fun (S : Finset (Fin m)) (z : X) => ∀ y ∉ S, z y = 0
  let agrees := fun (i : Fin a) (U V : State) =>
    ∀ z : X, supported (cut i.val ∩ cut (i.val+1)) z → (z ∈ U ↔ z ∈ V)
  let fits := fun (B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2)) (i : Fin a) (j : ℕ) (U : State) =>
    (∀ z ∈ U, supported (cut j) z ∧ ∀ x ∈ rows i, B.mulVec z x = 0) ∧
    rk A R Finset.univ + rk B (rows i) (bags i.val) + (cut j).card ≤
      2*t + rk A R (bags i.val) + rk B (rows i) (cut j) + Module.finrank (ZMod 2) U
  let cells := fun i : Fin a => (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin m)).filter
    (fun z => row z.1 = some i ∧ z.2 ∈ bags i.val ∧ z.2 ≠ q)
  ((∀ (P : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    (∀ g ∈ Q.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) Q →
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents P Q → depth (n+m) Q ≤ 1 → Q.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t →
    (∀ x y, row x = none → P x y = T x y) → (∀ x, P x q = T x q) →
    E ≤ ∑ i : Fin a, ((cells i).filter (fun z => P z.1 z.2 ≠ T z.1 z.2)).sum w) ↔
    2*t < rk A R Finset.univ ∨ ∃ h : ℕ → State → ℕ, h 0 ⊥ = 0 ∧ E ≤ h a ⊥ ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin a) (U V : State) (F : Finset (Fin n × Fin m)), F ⊆ cells i →
        let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun x y => A x y + (if (x,y) ∈ F then 1 else 0)
        agrees i U V → fits B i i.val U → fits B i (i.val+1) V →
          h (i.val+1) V ≤ h i.val U + F.sum w)

∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j+3 ≤ t →
  let h := 3*t-2-j
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 5) ht)⟩ : Fin n)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (i : Fin n) => w (ix (i.val + n - s % n))
  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let a := 3*t
  let evenBit := fun (w : W) (i : Fin a) => mix w (ix (2*i.val))

let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]

  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,

∃ write parity : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast parity ∧

∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
  let hist := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f ∧ size f = s}

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  ∃ (k shift mult : Nat) (a : Fin k → Nat) (w : Fin k → Fin k → Nat),
    k ≤ n ∧ shift ≤ n/2 ∧ (∀ i, 1 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ n) ∧
    (∀ i, w i i = 0) ∧ (∀ i j, w i j = w j i ∧ w i j ≤ 5*a i*a j) ∧
    let cells := (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange k).map (fun j => (i,j)))
    let edges := cells.toFinset.filter (fun z => z.1 < z.2)
    let verts := fun z : Fin k × Fin k => ({z.1,z.2} : Finset (Fin k))
    let good := edges.powerset.filter (fun Q => ∀ g ∈ Q, ∀ h ∈ Q, g ≠ h → Disjoint (verts g) (verts h))
    write input = header k ++ frame shift ++ frame mult ++
      (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => frame (a i)) ++ cells.flatMap (fun z => frame (w z.1 z.2)) ∧
    parity input = (List.range (n/2+1)).map (fun s => (hist s).testBit 0) ∧
    (∀ s : Nat, hist s = if s < shift then 0 else
      mult*(good.filter (fun Q => Q.card = s-shift)).sum (fun Q =>
        ((Finset.univ \ Q.biUnion verts).prod a) * Q.prod (fun z => w z.1 z.2)))
